meta.requirement: Explore Wolvendom (10%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Those Were The Days
start.text:
''Smoke curls from a small fire ring. Three hilichurls slouch around it, and not one of them reaches for a club when you step into the clearing. One of them lifts a hand in what might be a wave.''

Hilichurl: Olah! ''grins'' Mosi mosi yoyo.

''You try a greeting of your own. You point at the fire, at yourself, at the trees. The hilichurl tilts its head, says "Mita movo mi" with great confidence, and goes back to poking the embers. Whatever this is, it is not going anywhere. But they are not hostile either.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Decide what to do about the friendly hilichurls

left_in_peace.title: Left in Peace
left_in_peace.text:
''You lower your hand and step back. The hilichurl by the fire watches you go, then gives another lazy wave and points off through the trees toward a cluster of tents. An invitation, maybe. Strange company, but peaceful enough.''

''You make a note of where their camp lies.''

atk_hili.text:
''You raise your weapon. The mood by the fire turns at once. Two of the larger hilichurls heave themselves upright, clubs swinging off their shoulders, and a low growl rolls through the clearing.''

Hilichurl: Mosi mosi... ''the friendliness is gone'' Gusha!

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Attack the Hilichurls. Defeat 2 [[Hilichurl Berserker]]s

hilichurls_defeated.title: Hilichurls Defeated
hilichurls_defeated.text: ''The last berserker thuds into the dirt and the clearing goes quiet. Among the scattered camp you turn up a small purse of Silver they had no use for.''
